value.rationale: Prescribed-commutator fiber sizes refine the natural image problem for polynomial maps on a split alternative algebra. The formula determines every nonzero fiber, distinguishes its quadratic norm character by an exact q^8-q^6 bias, and gives exact frequency populations for all finite fields of odd characteristic. This arithmetic information is not supplied by known zero-centralizer data or image surjectivity, and is a motivated complete invariant rather than an arbitrary slice.
